results.content: I have very strong passion in teaching. From Fall 2011 to Spring 2022, there have been over 2,600 PKU students taking my class room teaching in total. In 2021, I was recognized by the "Excellent Teaching Service Award" of Peking University, where only 5 awardees were recognized from all disciplines.
